description: Read-only Peloton workout, class, and structural-provider facts in a private local store.

auth_env_var_specs.name: PELOTON_OAUTH_USERNAME
auth_env_var_specs.description: Your Peloton login email or username, used to log in automatically. Not needed if a session from a prior login is already persisted.

auth_env_var_specs.name: PELOTON_OAUTH_PASSWORD
auth_env_var_specs.description: Your Peloton account password, used to log in automatically. Not needed if a session from a prior login is already persisted.

novel_features.name: Automatic Peloton login
novel_features.description: Shows how to supply PELOTON_OAUTH_USERNAME/PELOTON_OAUTH_PASSWORD; the CLI logs in and persists credentials automatically, no external provisioning service involved.
